statements: ALTER TABLE credentials ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS totp_encrypted TEXT
ALTER TABLE credentials DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_credentials_totp_encrypted
ALTER TABLE credentials ADD CONSTRAINT ck_credentials_totp_encrypted CHECK (totp_encrypted IS NULL OR totp_encrypted LIKE 'v1:%')
ALTER TABLE credential_access_log DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_credential_access_log_action
ALTER TABLE credential_access_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_credential_access_log_action CHECK (action IN ('reveal','copy','create','update','share','delete','totp'))
